Body.Content:
Anomaly Detector, a new service within Azure Cognitive Services, is now available. Easily embed anomaly detection capabilities into your apps to quickly identify problems and help minimize loss and customer impact. Activate the pre-trained AI model through a single API call that ingests time-series data of all types and volumes, selects the best-fitting anomaly detection model for your data to ensure high accuracy, and automatically surfaces incidents as soon as they happen. Customize the service as needed to detect anomalies of any size.

Learn more
